description: Count occurrences matching a taxon + location filter without fetching records. Use for quick totals ("how many Aves records in Sweden?") or before deciding whether to paginate a full search. Accepts taxonKey, country (uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), publishingCountry, stateProvince, gadmGid, scientificName, spatial ranges and geometry (intersected), month, basisOfRecord, hasCoordinate (alias isGeoreferenced), isInCluster, coordinateUncertaintyInMeters, datasetKey, year, catalogNumber, institutionCode, recordedBy, mediaType, occurrenceStatus, and iucnRedListCategory. Counts sightings only by default, matching gbif_search_occurrences — GBIF also indexes absence records, and for some taxa they are the overwhelming majority. A count above 100,001 is the signal to partition rather than page: gbif_search_occurrences cannot reach past that offset, so split the query by DATASET_KEY via gbif_occurrence_facets and search each dataset separately.

basisOfRecord.description: Filter by how the occurrence was recorded; accepts every GBIF BasisOfRecord vocabulary member.

catalogNumber.description: Catalog number a collection assigned to the specimen or record (e.g. "L.1592880"), matched as the whole value, case-insensitively. Not unique across collections — one number can name records in several datasets, so pair it with institutionCode or datasetKey to single one out. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty radius in meters, e.g. "0,1000"; range endpoints inclusive. Omit for any uncertainty; blank or whitespace-only is rejected.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase, of where the occurrence was recorded (e.g., "GB", "US"). Not the publisher's country — that is publishingCountry, and the two disagree on most records. Lowercase and alpha-3 forms ("gb", "USA") match nothing upstream, which is why only the uppercase two-letter form is accepted here. Take a value from a COUNTRY facet on gbif_occurrence_facets; an uppercase pair GBIF does not know ("XX") is rejected upstream by name.

datasetKey.description: Filter to a specific dataset UUID (8-4-4-4-12 hex) from gbif_search_datasets. Omit the field to count across every dataset — an empty string is rejected rather than read as no filter, because GBIF answers a blank datasetKey with the unfiltered total. The result is not the recordCount the dataset tools and the gbif://dataset/{datasetKey} resource report for the same key: that figure spans every occurrenceStatus, while this count applies occurrenceStatus below, PRESENT by default.

decimalLatitude.description: Latitude or latitude range "min,max" in decimal degrees (WGS84). All supplied spatial filters intersect, including geometry. Omit to leave latitude unbounded; blank or whitespace-only is rejected.

decimalLongitude.description: Longitude or longitude range "min,max" in decimal degrees (WGS84). All supplied spatial filters intersect, including geometry. Omit to leave longitude unbounded; blank or whitespace-only is rejected.

gadmGid.description: GADM administrative-area GID at any level: country (ESP), state or province (ESP.1_1), county or district (ESP.1.5_1), or municipality (ESP.1.6.3_1). GBIF derives a record's GIDs from its coordinates, so records without coordinates match none, and the unit can differ from the verbatim stateProvince the record carries. Matched exactly and case-sensitively, and a GID holds only uppercase letters, digits, dots, and underscores — any other character is rejected. Take one from a GADM_LEVEL_0_GID, GADM_LEVEL_1_GID, GADM_LEVEL_2_GID, or GADM_LEVEL_3_GID facet on gbif_occurrence_facets, or from the gadm field of gbif_get_occurrence; a well-formed GID GBIF does not hold matches zero records rather than erroring. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

geometry.description: WKT polygon in longitude latitude order. All supplied spatial filters intersect: decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude remain active and restrict results to the overlap. Omit to leave geometry unfiltered; blank or whitespace-only is rejected.

hasCoordinate.description: True counts records with coordinates; false counts only records without coordinates. Omit for both. Alias isGeoreferenced may be supplied alone or with the same value; conflicts fail as invalid_filter.

institutionCode.description: Code of the institution holding the record (e.g. "K", "CLO"), matched as the whole value, case-insensitively — part of a code or of a multi-word code matches nothing. An INSTITUTION_CODE facet on gbif_occurrence_facets lists the codes in a scope, lowercased, and this filter takes them unchanged. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

isGeoreferenced.description: Alias for hasCoordinate. True counts only georeferenced records; false only non-georeferenced records. Supplying both requires equal values.

isInCluster.description: True counts likely duplicates; false excludes them. Omit to include all records. GBIF exposes membership only, with no cluster identifier.

iucnRedListCategory.description: Count only records whose taxon carries this IUCN Red List category: CR Critically Endangered, EN Endangered, VU Vulnerable, NT Near Threatened, LC Least Concern, DD Data Deficient, EX Extinct, EW Extinct in the Wild, CD Conservation Dependent. Records with no category are excluded when this is set.

mediaType.description: Only records carrying at least one media item of this type: StillImage (photographs, scans), MovingImage (video), Sound (audio), or InteractiveResource. Records without media are excluded when this is set.

month.description: Calendar month (1–12), matching the occurrence search filter.

occurrenceStatus.description: Presence/absence filter. Defaults to PRESENT: an ABSENT record documents a survey that looked for the taxon and did not find it, so counting one inflates the total with the opposite of a sighting. Use ANY for both (GBIF's own default), or ABSENT for non-observations alone. Matches the gbif_search_occurrences default, so the two tools agree.

publishingCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase, of the organization that published the record — distinct from where the occurrence was observed, which is country. Take a value from a PUBLISHING_COUNTRY facet on gbif_occurrence_facets. Lowercase and alpha-3 forms ("us", "USA") match nothing upstream, which is why only the uppercase two-letter form is accepted here.

recordedBy.description: Collector or observer, matched against each name in the record's recordedBy list (GBIF splits it on "|") exactly and case-sensitively: "Charles Darwin" and "charles darwin" differ, and one person written two ways ("Charles Darwin", "Darwin, C.") is two values. Take a value from a RECORDED_BY facet on gbif_occurrence_facets scoped the same way and pass it back unchanged; an unmatched value matches zero records rather than erroring. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

scientificName.description: Scientific name; does not match synonyms. With taxonKey GBIF takes their union (OR), not their intersection. Omit to leave names unfiltered; blank or whitespace-only is rejected.

stateProvince.description: State, province, or first-level administrative division, matched as a verbatim string — exact and case-sensitive. GBIF stores what each dataset recorded without normalizing it, so there is no vocabulary to guess from: "England", "England - Greater London", and "Greater London" are three distinct values, and "england" is none of them. Take one from a STATE_PROVINCE facet on gbif_occurrence_facets scoped the same way and pass it back unchanged — an unmatched value counts zero rather than erroring. Omit the field to count across every state or province — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered total.

taxonKey.description: GBIF backbone taxon key from gbif_match_species. Matches the given taxon and all descendant taxa (subspecies, varieties, etc.).

year.description: Year or year range (e.g., "2024" or "2020,2024"). Both endpoints inclusive. Omit the field to count across every year — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered total.

name: gbif_count_occurrences

count.description: Total occurrences matching the supplied filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A string filter other than country and publishingCountry was supplied blank or whitespace-only (a blank country or publishingCountry fails earlier, at its uppercase pattern, as -32602 invalid_arguments), hasCoordinate conflicts with isGeoreferenced, datasetKey is not an 8-4-4-4-12 hex UUID, gadmGid holds a character other than an uppercase letter, digit, dot, or underscore, a two-letter country or publishingCountry code is one GBIF does not know, or GBIF rejected another filter value as malformed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the count is zero under an exact-match stateProvince, gadmGid, or recordedBy filter, larger than gbif_search_occurrences can page to, or narrowed by a presence/absence filter. Absent when none applies.

occurrenceStatus.description: The presence/absence filter applied upstream — PRESENT, ABSENT, or ANY when no filter was sent. Says what the count covers.

scope.description: Effective supplied biological filters, with occurrenceStatus always included; excludes pagination and facet controls.

title: Count Occurrences
